name: Log Retention MUST be 90 Days Hot / 1 Year Cold (managed centrally) to ensure sufficient evidence is available for all security incident investigations.
conditionsText: Services that use cloud storage solutions, there may be some other conditions
requirementTitle: Log Retention MUST be 90 Days Hot / 1 Year Cold (managed centrally) to ensure sufficient evidence is available for all security incident investigations.
requirementDescription: Security and audit logs must be kept in a searchable format for at least 90 days and archived for at least 1 year, so investigators have enough evidence if a security incident is discovered.
why: For incident investigations security teams need to know when the attack started, which accounts were affected, what data was accessed etc. Many organisations need to be able to demonstrate security monitoring and the logs support this
